runtimeContract.output: bounded PNG binary descriptor image/png with sourceSha256/sha256/width/height
runtimeContract.svgPolicy: local generated SVG only; tag/attribute/paint/numeric allowlist; no href/style/script/foreignObject/DOCTYPE/ENTITY; SVG never displayed
runtimeContract.cancellation: cooperative checks around synchronous CAD parse/native raster; owned worker supplies hard timeout/cancel

nativeHelper.api: static Task ShowAsync(IWorkspaceServices services, DocumentContext context, AssetInfo asset)

tests.scope: synthetic real ASCII DXF lines/circle/label; library-generated DWG2018 decoding; PNG visible content/SHA/input immutability; malformed/budget/cancel; SVG attacks

knownLimits: Preview is raster, not CAD editing/export or dimensional verification.
External real-company DWG/DXF and fonts/layout are not independently approved.
Generated DWG positive is this library writer-reader compatibility, not AutoCAD proof.
Unsupported/corrupt files fail explicitly; binary DXF is not supported by the ASCII-DXF header gate.
Synchronous CAD parse/raster cannot be interrupted inside that call; worker process timeout/hard cancel remains required.
Original NASJI renderer algorithm is retained; this is Hybrid JS runtime plus native WinForms viewer, not pure C# CAD engine.
